why: `corpus/` holds two asks addressed to its `upstream` dependency under `.yidam/asks/upstream/`, one open and one answered (contract 0.33.0). An ask is a question this repository has of a corpus it depends on and is listed beside the open questions, never among them. Three servers fail here, each on its own count: one that folds asks into `open_questions` answers four there instead of three; one that lists every ask rather than every open one answers two under `asks`; and one that predates the key has no `asks` at all. `everyItemHas` pins the entry to its package and to the pin it was read against, which is the information a hand-kept outbox loses.
